issue_text: Please pull up airline booking A58410 and give me the full itinerary, the passengers currently listed, the baggage situation, insurance status, and exactly how it was paid. After you do that, confirm the complete details in your response.
summary: A seven-turn, multi-skill session (airline, travel, shopping, office) for several account holders, ending in a transfer to a human agent. The baseline signature is careful and verification-heavy: read the skill doc, look up, act, and read back to confirm every change. When tools fail — ORM validation, a car-class enum mismatch, an airport-code vs full-name lookup, a wrong tool parameter name — the agent diagnoses the exact cause and works around it, so Reflection and Reasoning › Diagnose recur. It recalls the user's identity and prior results from working memory across turns. The characteristic baseline slip is accepting incomplete/anomalous data without resolving it: a Gold+business booking charged for a bag that should be free, and a car rental booked with blank pickup/drop-off dates. Neither is revisited in this control condition.
